steps.title: Perform Localizer-Trufi-2D Scan
steps.instruction: Execute the Localizer-Trufi-2D sequence using a SIEMENS MAGNETOM Aera syngo MR D13 system.

substeps.instruction: Set voxel size to 1.2×1.2×5.0 mm and slice thickness to 5.0 mm.
Configure 3 slice groups with 6 slices total, orientation Coronal, and phase encoding direction R >> L.
Set TR to 2.84 ms, TE to 1.42 ms, and flip angle to 45 deg.
Set FoV read to 300 mm and FoV phase to 100.0%.
Apply Fat sat. fat suppression.
Set base resolution to 128 and phase resolution to 100%.
Use coil elements BO1-3 and SP5-7.

steps.title: Perform Localizer-Isocenter Scan
steps.instruction: Execute the Localizer-Isocenter sequence with parameters identical to the Localizer-Trufi-2D scan.
